run_flux_inference_xla: run FLUX.1 image inference on XLA devices with configurable width, height, and guidance scale
run_flux_inference_schnell: run FLUX.1 schnell model inference on XLA with reduced 4-step generation
run_flux_inference_profiled: run FLUX.1 inference on XLA with profiler enabled and configurable profile duration
run_flux_inference_benchmark: run FLUX.1 inference on XLA across multiple iterations and report average inference time
run_flux_inference_cached: run FLUX.1 inference on XLA with compiler cache and FlashAttention enabled for performance
